subject: expression: Add cast to ensure that the actual output type of `builtin_control` is consistent with retType (#46786)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: adds `newBaseBuiltinFuncWithFieldTypes` to insert precise CASTs for DECIMAL/DATETIME/TIMESTAMP/DURATION branches in IF/IFNULL/CASE, and refactors `InferType4ControlFuncs` to variadic with explicit handling for IF/IFNULL/CASE/LEAD/LAG. Verified call sites only use supported function names (no new panic surface in-repo), and vectorized IF semantics remain guarded by fallback on warnings/errors. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` (including post-move `pkg/expression/*`); no subsequent functional fix suggests an unresolved Blocker/High issue in this change.
